name: ซันแอนด์มูน GX Starter Deck ศึกตำนาน

description.text: GX Starter Deck: Legendary Clash, released as more TAG TEAM cards arrived: a random ready-to-play 60-card deck with one Pokémon-GX, damage counters, a GX marker and a rule book. Its pool includes Arceus & Dialga & Palkia-GX and Charizard & Braixen-GX. This set holds every card the decks could contain.
